title: Short Narrow Wooden rolling pin
text: Short Narrow Wooden rolling pin. Size is worth a five star...  roller itself is of good quality... but extremely stiff and handles do not roll easily... This makes precise rolling difficult and results in uneven surfaces. Bought this to roll ceramic slabs for tiles... Pressure issue is unfortunate. Anticipate it might eventually roll easier but initially a bit disappointing.  If you are using for pastry would be less of an issue
